name: Cover-Recursive Peripheral Construction
statement: A finite partial cube belongs to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$ when it lies in the least class containing $K_1$ and closed under $G=(B\times\{0\})\cup(S\times\{1\})$, where $S$ is isometric in $B$ and both $B$ and $S$ belong to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$.
